decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is core hardware close to the established offer, was featured on the home page, and carries heavy R&D and production investment that management will defend.
The backside numbering software module is a niche add-on with low visibility, but it costs little to maintain and supports the announced serialization direction, so management keeps it.
The inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces extends core coding technology and ink expertise, so dropping it would undercut earlier commitments and a key customer need.
The decoding app had its own page and fits the publicly announced digitalization and traceability strategy, so any weak uptake is likely blamed on early adoption rather than the product.
Inline code verification is central to end-to-end traceability and compliance, the direction the firm has committed to, so it stays.
The layout design software was promoted on the home page and underpins common operation across the firm's systems, making it a visible commitment management will persist with.
